WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain,
         COUNT(*) AS exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE expirespot::text BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY ordersmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS avg_of_order_avg_remaincount,
       SUM(exec_count) AS total_execution_count
FROM per_order;
